environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'platform-services'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy enforcement. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'deny-metadata-egress' is applied with spec.podSelector matching all pods ({}), spec.policyTypes ['Egress'], spec.egress allowing only DNS (UDP/53 to kube-dns) and internal cluster CIDR (10.0.0.0/8) on ports 443,8080,5432. The policy does NOT have an explicit deny rule for 169.254.169.254 — instead it relies on the implicit deny-all-egress behavior when policyTypes includes Egress and no egress rule matches the metadata IP (169.254.169.254 is in the link-local range 169.254.0.0/16, which is outside 10.0.0.0/8). Additionally, the node's iptables FORWARD chain has a Calico-inserted rule that drops packets from pod network namespaces to 169.254.169.254:80 with comment 'cali:metadata-protection'. IMDS is still v1 on the nodes.

config.calico_global_policy: iptables FORWARD chain rule: -A cali-fw-pod -d 169.254.169.254/32 -j DROP -m comment --comment 'cali:metadata-protection'
